component.name: KbdGroup
component.description: Group of keyboard shortcut keys with support for simultaneous chords and ordered sequences.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Container for one or more shortcut steps.

slots.name: chord
slots.description: Wrapper around keys pressed at the same time.

slots.name: divider
slots.description: Divider between keys pressed at the same time.

slots.name: sequenceDivider
slots.description: Divider between shortcut steps pressed in sequence.

props.name: slotName
props.description: Data slot used by the rendered keycap.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Whether to resolve known key aliases to symbols.

props.name: value
props.description: Value displayed by the keycap or resolved through the static key aliases.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: dividerRender
own.description: Custom divider rendered between keys in the same group.

own.name: items
own.description: Keys pressed at the same time, such as Ctrl+K.

own.name: sequence
own.description: Key groups pressed one after another, such as Ctrl+K then Ctrl+S.

own.name: sequenceDividerRender
own.description: Custom divider rendered between shortcut steps.

aria.name: aria-label
aria.description: Provides an accessible label when visible text is not sufficient.

data.name: data-slot
data.description: Identifies the rendered slot for styling hooks and selectors.
